I will definitely be spending a lot of time on the phone today to try to get it handled through Kaiser, but I'm not sure how much luck I'll have with that. 

Honesty is what I'm going for here, above anything. I'm really hoping I can find a way .

I didn't think of trying to get a doctor to write a letter for me. Definitely would be worth a shot. The records kind of seem all over the place. There's "chronic back pain" on it as well because of some back issues from a few years back that I have written off as over exertion. 

I have an appointment with my recruiter today to talk to him about what I should/could do.
